findings.summary: the worker is shown nothing after confirming a published week
findings.detail: pages/admin/workforce-me.vue:751 `acknowledge()` writes the #44 receipt into `ackReceipts` and then reloads the inbox. Acknowledging implies seen, so the item returns `isRead: true`, `unreadPublications()` (utils/workforce-me/inbox-filter.js:114) drops it, and the whole `WorkforcePublicationNotice` section is v-if'd away — taking the receipt line (WorkforcePublicationNotice.vue:17-19) with it. There is no toast on the success path (only on failure, :761), so the worker gets NO confirmation of an act the law-facing side of this module treats as evidence. The receipt renderer is unreachable in production: it needs an item that is unread AND acknowledged, and the acknowledging is what makes it read.

findings.summary: the already-acknowledged replay string is unreachable
findings.detail: `wfme_pub_receipt_already` and the `alreadyAcknowledged: true` branch of WorkforcePublicationNotice.vue:75-78 have no browser-reachable caller: the acknowledge button lives inside the notice, and the first press removes the notice. Survives a reload, so the worker cannot re-read or re-confirm what they acknowledged.

findings.summary: a manager cannot see who acknowledged a published week
findings.detail: The worker acknowledgement (#44) is written and receipted on the worker's own screen, but no manager-facing read of publication recipients is bound in the frontend — `utils/workforce/schedule-client.js` binds `GetPublicationHistory` and no recipient list. The publish toast's `recipientCount` is a send-time count and is not evidence of receipt. A venue that must show it rostered someone cannot produce that from this UI.
